exposure: maternal experience of interpersonal partner violence
age of screening (1.5 years vs. 5 years)
cohort: A population cohort of 1258 pregnant women in 24 neighborhoods and their children, followed from pregnancy through 5 years post-birth.
finding: Children can be screened and diagnosed for FASD at 1.5 and 5 years, with positive screening rates more than doubling by 5 years, and maternal socioeconomic factors being associated with a positive FASD screen.
